name: Brunhild Emberhold
features: Fighting Style: Defense (+1 AC while wearing armor)
Second Wind (bonus action, regain 1d10+9 HP, once per short rest)
Action Surge (one additional action, once per short rest)
Extra Attack (two attacks per Attack action)
Indomitable (reroll a failed saving throw, once per long rest)
Combat Superiority (four superiority dice, d8; recover on short rest)
Maneuvers: Trip Attack, Riposte, Precision Attack, Menacing Attack, Disarming Attack
Know Your Enemy (learn a creature's relative combat capabilities after study)
Dwarven Resilience (advantage on saves vs. poison, resistance to poison damage)
Stonecunning (double proficiency on History checks related to stonework)
traits: Dwarven Combat Training (proficient with battleaxe, handaxe, light hammer, warhammer)
Dwarven Armor Training (proficient with light and medium armor)
Anvil-steady: refuses to be moved from a line she has sworn to hold

personality.traits: I plant my boots and dare the world to move me. I size up a battlefield the way a mason sizes up a wall.
personality.ideals: Greater Good. The strong stand in front so the weak may stand at all.
personality.bonds: The Ashen Vow gave my shattered clan a purpose again; I will not fail the oath they set upon me.
personality.flaws: I would rather take a blow meant for another than admit I cannot win a fight.

appearance: A granite-shouldered mountain dwarf of 4'6", her copper beard forked and bound in blackened iron clasps. Old forge-burns mottle her forearms, and a fresh ashfall of grey dusts her plate no matter how often she polishes it. She stands with the immovable patience of a foundation stone.
backstory: Brunhild held the last gate of Emberhold Deep when a fire-touched incursion boiled up from a collapsed magma vent — the first tremor of the Emberscar to reach the mountain holds. Her shield wall broke; she alone did not. The Ashen Vow order found her weeks later, still standing guard over a tomb of her kin, and offered her a purpose worthy of her stubbornness: cross into the flame itself and shut the wound at its source. She took the oath before they finished the offer.
